instances.note: A1–A7/E1–E5: keep for pending staging. Cremșnit is a familiar named pastry supported by two independently authored Romanian recipe sources, with a recognizable dough-plus-vanilla-cream assembly. The five seeds Făină, Apă, Lapte, Vanilie and Zahăr are familiar, category-coherent and each has an actual role in the sparse book. On final proposed graph module 5fa229dd7332b489f509ba9b4f6b7b1e13f71954a6ce86999cc31d69d528a249, independently executed all 10 seed pairs: four are productive, and none reveals the target in one opening. Făină+Apă→Aluat and Lapte+Vanilie→Cremă de vanilie are two intuitive openings. Milk+sugar and sugar+vanilla are looser association openings, not sufficient cooking instructions. Combine the two discoveries for Cremșnit: three actions at par, five bounded recipe pairs and three routes; all three fresh actual-BFF private journeys won at 1000 and preserved score/moves on resume and repeated completion. No seed is unused across the book, no target/alias is a seed, and no full route or hidden target ID appears before discovery. Bounded sparse choices avoid reopening the broad graph closure. The generic Aluat node abstracts the pastry sheets; the game offers ingredient associations rather than a complete recipe with every real ingredient. Diplomat is absent from this exact raw file and remains held after factual and projection screening; its earlier mechanical success is not approval.
